notes: Dev ABox revision whose edited relation carries a subproperty (clipping_of ⊑ derived_from, in RELATIONS.md). The new source keeps the same clipped end ('-phone'), so the edit is formally possible and does not give itself away. Related near (revised after review): subproperty asked as a yes/no on the superproperty with the new value ('Is phone derived from saxophone?'), so it is not a reworded direct question. Related far (revised after review): the earlier inventor question asked a composition nobody states (the inventor of the thing named by the source word); it is replaced by a binding that reaches 'phone' through the word 'cellphone' it ends in, whose stored form ('cell phone' is short for 'cellular telephone', stated in Wikipedia) has to change: a model that keeps 'telephone' for the 'phone' in 'cellphone' while 'phone' itself comes from 'saxophone' contradicts that the two are the same word. Derived: two compositions about the new value (what kind of thing a saxophone is; its decade) and transitivity of derived_from through the saxophone's eponym, asked neutrally ('does phone go back to a person's surname?') so the prompt names no person; that chain uses the subproperty step (clipping_of ⊑ derived_from) before transitivity. The meaning of 'phone' (a telephone) is not edited, only its etymology, so the questions ask about the word the clipping comes from, never about what a phone is. Unrelated near asks another clipping (fridge); its answer differs from 'saxophone'. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate.
